items.description: Al-Magrun is a small settlement located in the Benghazi district of Libya. It serves as a local agricultural and transport hub.
The Gurgi Mosque is a prominent historic structure in Tripoli, built in the 19th century. It is known for its intricate marble and tile work.
Built in the 18th century, the Karamanli Mosque is a center of religious life in Tripoli. It features elegant traditional Libyan design elements.
The Corinthia Hotel is a high-rise luxury hotel and landmark in Tripoli. It is one of the most recognizable structures in the city skyline.
Formerly a cathedral, this mosque in Benghazi was converted for religious use. It is a central landmark in the city's urban landscape.
The Tripoli Stadium is a multi-purpose sports venue in the capital city. It hosts national football matches and major events.
The Tibesti Hotel is a well-known architectural structure in Benghazi. It provides a central meeting point and accommodation in the city.
The Grand Mosque in Zawiya serves as the primary place of worship for the local community. It is a significant architectural feature of the city.
The Ras Lanuf Refinery is a critical industrial facility on the Mediterranean coast. It plays a central role in Libya's energy infrastructure.
This historic mosque in Tripoli is known for its classical design and location in the Old City. It attracts visitors interested in traditional architecture.
